title: Shared definitions for the LuckyDraw section 15 records
description: Primitive shapes reused by every record schema. The host luckydraw.invalid is the RFC 2606 reserved TLD: these identifiers are never fetched, they only give each schema a stable base URI for $ref resolution.

address.description: EVM address, lowercase hex. Addresses are compared lowercase everywhere (SPEC section 10.3).

zeroAddress.description: The native BNB sentinel and the 'no pending owner' value (SPEC section 4.2, Types.sol NATIVE_ASSET).

uint256String.description: Unsigned 256-bit integer as a decimal string, never a JSON number (SPEC section 10.3). The validator additionally checks the value against 2^256-1.

isoDateTime.description: UTC instant, seconds precision, explicit Z. No local offsets.

sourceRef.description: Where a fact was verified and when (SPEC section 15). Null on both sides means 'not yet verified'.

environment.description: SPEC section 12: environment in {local, testnet, mainnet}.

decimals.description: Token or feed decimals, 0-18 (SPEC section 3.1, PriceReader.MAX_DECIMALS).

envVarName.description: Name of the environment variable that carries a URL or secret. The value itself is never committed (SPEC section 15 'Secret URLs not committed').

publicSafeText.description: Free text that may be published. Rejects IP literals, cloud region codes, OCIDs and provider host names, because section 15 Hosting forbids IP/region/instance identifiers in any published spec or build.

allOf.$comment: cloud region code such as a region-availability-domain pair
